subject: Re: MAP: Security gates & timeline for BankRight eval

Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: MAP: Security gates & timeline for BankRight eval

Rishi / Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is comfortable with the feature set and we want to formalize the MAP so procurement and security can sign off. High-level asks from our side:

- SOC 2 report (latest) + point of contact for any follow-up questions
- SIG / CAIQ questionnaire or summary answers we can drop into our intake
- DPA redlines (we run a standard template; flag anything that needs legal discussion)
- Data retention & residency: we need clarity on EU residency option and retention windows (30/90/365 days) and archival practices

Target timeline: pilot with synthetic traffic in mid-Sept, limited production by mid-Nov. Procurement would like a MAP that sequences the security gate checkpoints so they can plan procurement approval and budget release. Can you send a MAP draft and a proposed evidence schedule by early next week?

I attached our internal MAP template for reference.

Attachement: BankRight-MAP-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Lara

Subject: Re: MAP: Security gates & timeline for BankRight eval

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear summary and the template. Sending a first-pass MAP and the SOC snapshot for your intake team. High-level notes below; MAP pdf attached.

Key proposals (from Redwood):
- Acceptance milestones: (1) Evidence review complete (SOC 2 + SIG answers) — target 2026-08-20
  (2) Staging pilot (synthetic) — target 2026-09-15
  (3) Production enablement (limited) — target 2026-11-15
- Evidence sprint: we propose a 10-business-day focused window where your security team reviews SOC2 artifacts + CAIQ answers; Neha (security ops) will be the primary point for evidence intake.
- DPA: we can accept BankRight DPA redlines; we typically push back only on data residency carveouts that conflict with customer commitments. Please flag any must-have clauses.
- Retention/residency: we support region pinning (EU) for training/eval traffic and offer configurable token retention windows (30/90/365). We will document the default archival policy in the MAP.

Next steps:
1) Review attached Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf and SOC2-snapshot.pdf — comment inline or drop notes in the BankRight template.
2) Confirm whether EU residency is required for pilot or just for production.
3) If the MAP looks good, we can send a DocuSign version for signature and align on a mutual evidence sprint week (we have an open slot week of 2026-08-16).

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf (stub), SOC2-snapshot.pdf (stub)

Thanks — cc’ing Neha and Kimberly to own evidence sequencing and legal touchpoints.

—Rishi

Lara — quick note on the evidence flow and what we will need during the 10-business-day sprint. Quoting Rishi below for context.

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 10:05 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Key proposals (from Redwood):
> - Evidence sprint: we propose a 10-business-day focused window where your security team reviews SOC2 artifacts + CAIQ answers; Neha (security ops) will be the primary point for evidence intake.

For the sprint we will request the following minimal bundle (we can accept links to your evidence portal or shared Drive):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) + cover letter (PDF)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ (spreadsheet or exported PDF) — if you prefer we can pre-fill the CAIQ with our answers and you can drop comments
- DPA redline (PDF with tracked changes) or a list of specific clauses you need changed (we will escalate legal as needed)
- Data residency confirmation: whether EU region pinning is required for pilot vs production and any regulatory constraints around PV/PII

We can host the intake on a temporary shared folder and provide a checklist with owners for each evidence item. If BankRight can confirm the sprint week now (we are proposing 2026-08-16) we will reserve that slot and ship a short checklist doc the same day.

@Kimberly — if you have standard DPA language to surface, please add it; otherwise I’ll loop legal once BankRight returns their redlines.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Rishi / Neha / Kimberly,

Thanks — the MAP draft and SOC snapshot look good at a glance. Procurement and security discussed internally and we are aligned on the sprint week of 2026-08-16. Confirming:

- Evidence sprint week: 2026-08-16 (BankRight will upload SOC2 + CAIQ to the shared folder by EOD 2026-08-13)
- EU residency: required for production rollout; pilot can run in US with token-level anonymization
- DPA redlines: procurement will send a tracked redline by 2026-08-10 (we expect only minor carveouts)
- Target signoff: procurement aims to complete signature by 2026-08-27 so we can hit the 2026-09-15 pilot date
